name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Henderson library branch (Gibson, Green Valley, Paseo Verde or West Henderson). Tasks and hours are not listed on the page.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Paseo Verde Library has a 6 to 12 month wait.
how_to_apply: Download the Teen Volunteer Application (PDF on the page), fill it out and return it to the Customer Service desk at one of the four libraries. Questions: (702) 707-2665.
notes: Henderson is next to Las Vegas. Expect a wait at some branches. Ask about parent consent and hours.
